states.absent: no auction of the class is on the published schedule at the instant: a genuine zero (nothing settles)
states.cmb_pending: a cash management bill settling that day that was announced after the instant. It is on no published schedule (#738), so nothing at the instant can say it is coming: it is counted in step 1 in hindsight and is NOT part of the state, the flag or the per-forecast log
states.complete: the class is fully announced and an announced record carries a maturing estimate: a reading; a net of exactly 0.0 here is a genuine zero
states.day_level: a settlement day rests on a missing figure when either class is in missing_maturing, incomplete or unannounced
states.incomplete: some auctions of the class settling that day are announced and others on the published schedule are not (#679): the class is left out and reads 0.0
states.missing_maturing: fully announced, no announced record carries a maturing estimate (est_pub_held_mat_by_type_amt null): net_for_day reads the maturing amount as 0.0 and the class drains its whole offering
states.source: repo_model.net_settlement.net_state, per class (bill types, coupon types) of one settlement day at an instant; net_for_day is unchanged and returns the same numbers.
states.unannounced: auctions of the class are on the published schedule and none is announced: the class reads 0.0. Counted with 'incomplete' in the tables of classes not fully announced

label: development, not a verdict
reading_rules: A figure is a check on days that were already seen. Nothing here is a verdict, nothing is registered and no choice is made on it; (s3c-ann-net) stays the candidate of avenue #1318 and (s3c) the H5 candidate until she rules.
A gain or loss is read from the 90% interval of mean d excluding zero; otherwise undecided. A point estimate alone is not read.
A pooled figure is never read without the lead, regime and settlement-day-type splits beside it.

If a form should replace (s3c-ann-net), that goes to her as a marked question with numbered options and a default that changes no claim; the candidate does not change in this directive. Adopting the arm is her decision.
The CMB term is read with Lens E's caveat on the announcement time of a cash management bill.
